description: State Tourism Satellite Account is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Tourism Research Australia. The State Tourism Satellite Account (STSA) highlights the importance of tourism to each state and territory's economy. Key data includes consumption, Gross State Product (GSP), and employment. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: Report (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
